name: look-l8-habitats-elephant
note: look-l10-l8-2 (QA batch 26: "L8 is mostly APC and dark lawn"): L8 west loop past the elephant paddock: mud floor, water hole, hay feeder; grass verges and tree groves between the wall and the paddock. Look for: ground that reads as a place, warm pools off the route verge, nothing floating or sunk, no clipping, no flicker.
